title: Seepage Face
definition: A seepage face is the part of a sloping boundary where groundwater leaves the saturated zone at atmospheric pressure and discharges to the surface.[^1][^2] A hydrology paper describes a slope segment where groundwater discharges from the aquifer and flows overland and downslope toward a downstream water body, and a Wageningen University text defines a seepage surface as the boundary where water leaves the soil mass and continues to flow in a thin film along its surface.[^3][^1]
